instruction: 听全部五段材料，按2题、3题、3题、4题、3题的顺序完成全部15题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听前、听后各按每题5秒留时。审阅可重播，非正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The posters came out pale. Should I order darker ink?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The ink is fine. The paper is absorbing it too quickly. Try a smoother sheet before changing the colour.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I will test that on one poster first.

questions.stem: What does the man think caused the problem?
questions.rationale: A：明确纸吸收太快；B：明确墨水本身没问题；C：未谈字体大小

questions.stem: What will the woman do next?
options: Print a test on different paper.
questions.rationale: A：建议先不换墨；B：同意先试另一种纸；C：没有取消印刷

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The orchard owners agreed to our survey, but not during the apple harvest.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I expected that. Their workers will be too busy. Could we visit in November instead of September?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. The manager said the second week would be best.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We should change our research question too. We cannot count visitors if the orchard is closed to the public then.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We can interview the owners about how the harvest went. That would still give us useful evidence.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Agreed. I will revise the question list.

questions.stem: Why is September unsuitable for the visit?
options: The staff will be busy harvesting.
questions.rationale: A：无洪水；B：明确收获忙；C：未出国

questions.stem: When is the visit likely to take place?
questions.rationale: A：原计划已改；B：未定十月；C：明确十一月第二周

questions.stem: What research change do they agree on?
options: Interviewing owners instead of counting visitors.
Studying a different kind of fruit.
questions.rationale: A：闭园无法数游客改访谈收获；B：没有改水果品类；C：仍访谈非全用照片

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Your grandfather's old radio looks good in the display. Does it still work?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, but I decided not to switch it on during the exhibition. It picks up too much interference in that room.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then how will visitors hear what radio sounded like at the time?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I have a recording of him describing his favourite programmes. We can play that through a small modern speaker.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Have you checked that he is comfortable with people hearing it?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. He helped me choose the extract and asked me to remove one personal story.

questions.stem: Why will the old radio remain switched off?
options: The owner refused to lend it.
questions.rationale: A：未缺电源线；B：已在展中；C：明确房间干扰过大

options: A live broadcast through the old radio.
questions.rationale: A：播放祖父讲述的录音；B：不用旧机实时收听；C：不是维修指南

options: The man chose it without asking.
questions.rationale: A：明确征得同意且共同选择；B：祖父参与并要求删私事；C：无记者选段

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I have worked out the cost of the school magazine: eight hundred pounds for four hundred copies.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That is more than we expected. Could we print fewer copies?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The printer said three hundred would cost six hundred and sixty pounds, because setting up the machine costs the same.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We have three hundred paid orders already. Perhaps print three hundred and keep the digital version available for everyone else.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I worry that late buyers will miss out.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We can ask them to reserve a copy by Friday before confirming the final number. There is no need to guess.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. I will send the reservation form today. Should we cut the colour pages?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. Those pages show the art projects. We agreed they mattered more than the glossy cover, so use a plain cover instead.

questions.stem: What does the cheaper print quantity cost?
questions.rationale: A：400册价格；B：300册明确660；C：不是每册恒定两镑计算

questions.stem: How many paid orders are there?
questions.rationale: A：无200；B：400是原印量；C：明确300已付款订单

questions.stem: How will they decide the final number?
options: Assume last year's sales will repeat.
questions.rationale: A：通过截止预订减少猜测；B：未用往年猜测；C：不立即最大印量

questions.stem: Which feature will be reduced to save money?
questions.rationale: A：决定保留彩页；B：光面封改普通封；C：未删学生文章

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: This is an update on the old footpath behind the school. The council has agreed to repair the steps, but work cannot begin until a survey checks the retaining wall. Until then, the path will remain closed. Please do not move the temporary barriers. The alternative route through Mill Street adds about ten minutes to the walk. The school is not asking pupils to arrive earlier; the first morning activity will start ten minutes later while the closure continues. Students who use the public bus should follow the normal timetable, because its route is unchanged. We expect another update on Wednesday, but Wednesday is not a promised reopening date. Families will receive a message once the wall has been checked and a safe date has been confirmed.

questions.stem: What must happen before repairs begin?
options: The council must buy the land.
questions.rationale: A：未购地；B：公交路线不变；C：明确先勘测挡墙

questions.stem: What change will the school make?
options: Ask all pupils to arrive earlier.
questions.rationale: A：明确首个活动延迟十分钟；B：明确不要求提前；C：公交照常

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about Wednesday?
options: The path will certainly reopen then.
There should be another update then.
Repair work must finish by then.
questions.rationale: A：明确不是承诺重开日；B：预计再发更新；C：未承诺维修截止
